protocol: Cross the driver line to UAS-CsChrimson (LexAop-CsChrimson for a LexA line); raise adults on food with 0.4 mM all-trans-retinal for 3-5 days, in the dark. | Decapitate the fly under cold anaesthesia and let it recover for 5-10 min, tethered or free on a flat surface. | Deliver 1 s pulses of 617 nm light (several intensities), at least 10 pulses per fly, at least 8 flies per genotype. | Record the front legs at >= 100 frames/s; score each pulse for rhythmic front-leg stepping blind to genotype. | Controls: the empty split-GAL4 crossed to UAS-CsChrimson, and flies of the same cross raised without retinal.
